results.reply: A transformer is a neural network architecture introduced in 2017 that processes data (like text) using a mechanism called self-attention, which weighs how relevant each word is to every other word in a sequence. Unlike earlier models that read input one word at a time, transformers process the entire sequence in parallel, making them much faster to train and highly effective at capturing long-range relationships. This architecture powers virtually all modern large language models, including GPT, Claude, and Gemini.
